goal: the last Russian 7e works of the owner's list (3_КБ\_Все_сценарии.csv) playable from the base: Сны о Японии, Три кошмарных вечера (3 scenarios), Мифы Хастура, and the two solo adventures Наедине с Хэллоуином and Наедине с помехами (Р-230).
extra:
## This work (Р-230)

Each unit has its own `book_id` (see the unit). Records — book-scoped `<book_id>/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/<book_id>/<kinds>/`: scenario record, every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts (text as printed, image via `pipeline/art/add_images.py` when the handout is a picture), organizations, characters (statblocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters of the book), creatures (`instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`), places (inside existing shared cities — Grep `kb/locations/` first; places outside a city under «Окрестности <города>», Р-209; new cities only in `kb/locations/`). Maps — `map` with the image (`app/maps/<unit>-<slug>.jpg`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206), checked by eye on an overlay. New spells — create them in `kb/spells/` only if no record exists under any name (Grep names and English names); otherwise aliases via proposals. Dice with lowercase d everywhere (Р-27), metric units (Р-64; printed titles with measures go to `aliases`, Р-229).

- Fan translations (edition `trusted`: Сны о Японии, Мифы Хастура, both solo books): the Russian text is the source — do NOT set the `translated` flag; official Russian names of the base win (the fan forms go to `aliases`). Сны о Японии is a fan 7e adaptation of a 6e module: take its 7e numbers as printed; the English 6e original lies in the same library folder (`[EN 6e] … A Dream of Japan.pdf`) — use it only to check slips (record differences in `errata`/`corrections`).
- Solo adventures (Р-230, rule in docs/conventions.md): ONE scenario record with `solo: true`; every numbered paragraph in full, as printed, in a table «Абзацы» in `tables` (columns «№», «Текст», «Переходы»; checks and their outcomes stay in the paragraph text). Extract the paragraphs with a script from the text layer (`.cache/sources/<book_id>/text.txt`), then verify numbering 1…N has no gaps or duplicates and spot-check against page images; list any paragraph you could not read cleanly in the coverage file. `steps` — the big branches and the endings with refs. Characters, creatures, places, items, handouts, maps and the pregens (separate registered sheets: see the unit) — ordinary records.
- Mythos records already exist for Hastur, the King in Yellow, Carcosa, Lake Hali (`coc:creature:hastur`, `coc:creature:king-in-yellow`, `coc:location:carcosa`, Tatters of the King records in `kb/books/lokhmotya-korolya-ru/`) — link to them, change them only through proposals.
- `axes.ruleset` "core"; `axes.era` by the book's date (1920s / modern / other). Keep scratch files in `.cache/<unit>/`, never in the repo root. Coverage: `checks/20261113-ru-rest/<unit>.md` — every heading → record(s), «Не взято»; proposals `checks/20261113-ru-rest/proposals-<unit>.json`. No git.
